in_sanskrit.name: केशर्
in_sanskrit.meaning: hair, tuft, crest, king, lord, master, prince, chief, head, leader
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit words केश (hair) and शर् (tuft, crest). It carries the connotation of royalty, signifying a king or a chief. Thus, Kesar can be interpreted as 'royal hair' or 'king of hairs'.
